دودة الكمبيوتر الفيروسية  
A worm is a program that can replicate itself and send copies from computer to 
computer across network connections. Upon arrival, the worm may be activated 
to replicate and propagate again. In addition to propagation, the worm usually 
performs some unwanted function. An e-mail virus has some of the 
characteristics of a worm because it propagates itself from system to system. 
However, we can still classify it as a virus because it uses a document modified 
to contain viral macro content and requires human action. A worm actively seeks 
out more machines to infect, and each machine that is infected serves as an 
automated launching pad for attacks on other machines.
